creature_rhino.notes: Rhino (ForgeGUI): heavy grey armour plates, two faceted horns.

creature_rhino_lava.notes: Lava Rhino (ForgeGUI, mythic): charcoal rock split with glowing lava, a molten horn.

creature_jackal.notes: Jackal (ForgeGUI): tawny gold, a dark grey saddle, huge ears, a black-tipped tail.

creature_jackal_pharaoh.notes: Pharaoh Jackal (ForgeGUI, legendary): black, a gold and lapis headdress, gold bands, turquoise eyes and glyphs.

creature_cheetah.notes: Cheetah (ForgeGUI): lean gold with black spots and tear marks, a ringed tail.

creature_cheetah_lightning.notes: Lightning Cheetah (ForgeGUI, mythic): white and electric blue, glowing bolt-shaped spots.

creature_lion.notes: Lion (ForgeGUI): warm tan, a layered spiky brown mane.

creature_lion_sun.notes: Sun Lion (ForgeGUI, mythic): a mane of sun rays, a sun emblem on its hip.

creature_meerkat.notes: Meerkat (ForgeGUI): an upright sentinel, sandy with dark eye patches.

creature_meerkat_storm.notes: Storm Meerkat (ForgeGUI, legendary): slate blue, goggles, a storm cloud over its head, lightning at its feet.

creature_tortoise.notes: Tortoise (ForgeGUI): a tall olive shell of faceted scutes.

creature_tortoise_gemshell.notes: Gemshell Tortoise (ForgeGUI, legendary): a shell of cut gems in gold, crystals on its legs.

creature_flamingo.notes: Flamingo (ForgeGUI): faceted pink feathers; its wings are the back-leg pieces.

creature_flamingo_phoenix.notes: Phoenix Flamingo (ForgeGUI, mythic): feathers of flame, burning wings and tail.

creature_elephant.notes: Elephant (ForgeGUI, Titan): massive grey plates, ivory tusks, trunk raised.

creature_elephant_frost.notes: Frost Mammoth (ForgeGUI, mythic): shaggy white-blue fur, ice tusks, icicles.

foe_archer.notes: Shade archers: a hooded bowman; eyes, bowstring, arrow head and quiver fletching are Neon.

foe_mage.notes: Hex mages: a hooded, horned caster; eyes, runes, the palm orb and the staff crystal are Neon.

foe_knight.notes: Gloom knights: haunted armour with floating pieces; runes, eye slits, shield sigil and sword runes are Neon.

foe_ogre.notes: Ogres: a hunched brute with a spiked club; cracks, eyes, collar runes and club nails are Neon.

foe_dragon.notes: Hexfire dragons: the predator body with wings (wing_l, wing_r joints); eyes, wing veins and alternate spine spikes are Neon.

creature_lion_shadow.notes: Shadow Lion (ForgeGUI, legendary): purple-black with a violet mane and glowing eyes.

creature_elephant_war.notes: War Elephant (ForgeGUI, legendary): red and gold armour, a spiked helm, a howdah with a banner.

creature_jackal_sphinx.notes: Sphinx Jackal (ForgeGUI, mythic): cracked sandstone blocks, golden wings, an amber forehead mark.

creature_cheetah_fire.notes: Fire Cheetah (ForgeGUI, legendary): ember spots, flames along its spine and tail.

creature_flamingo_peacock.notes: Peacock Flamingo (ForgeGUI, legendary): teal and emerald, a fan of eyed tail feathers, a crest.

creature_meerkat_star.notes: Star Meerkat (ForgeGUI, mythic): a night-sky coat of stars and constellations, a gold star on its brow.

creature_rhino_crystal.notes: Crystal Rhino (ForgeGUI, legendary): a rhino of faceted grey stone plates studded with cut gems, clear crystals along its back, a crystal horn.

creature_tortoise_island.notes: Island Tortoise (ForgeGUI, mythic): a tropical island on its shell, palm, flowers and a waterfall.

egg_meadow.notes: Meadow Egg: cream dappled green, in a nest of grass and daisies, a flowering vine, a butterfly.

egg_wild.notes: Wild Egg: leaf-green with bark spots, bound in thorned vines, ferns and Neon mushrooms at its foot.

egg_safari.notes: Safari Egg: sand-gold, spotted and painted, roped and strapped, hung with feathers and a tooth.

egg_golden.notes: Golden Egg: beaten gold, hooped and ribbed, set with Neon violet gems, crowned, on a clawed stand.

hub_floor.notes: The plaza's floor: warm cobbles in rings, a round of pale flags, a band of brick.

hub_fire.notes: The fire pit and the two rows of curved benches round it. Its flames are the glow.

hub_market.notes: The market: five striped stalls, crates and barrels, the egg seller's cart.

hub_cafe.notes: The cafe: an open hut with a counter and an awning, four tables under parasols.

hub_stage.notes: The stage: a roofed platform with a painted back, lamps along its front, three rows of benches.

hub_green.notes: The green: the meeting tree with its bench, swing and lanterns, a pond with a pier, a trough, picnic tables.

hub_lights.notes: Lamps on the kerb, strings of flags from a ring of poles, planters.

hub_signs.notes: A finger post at each road, the notice board, the arch over the south walk.

kit_gym_bar.notes: The Strength Gym's barbell, on its stands: the animal under it lifts it.

kit_library_crystal.notes: The Magic Library's great crystal in its gold band: it turns over the open book.

kit_guard_ram.notes: A Guard Yard ram's log with its padded head: it swings at the animal on the pad.

home_house_1.notes: The Ranch House: a timber cottage on a fieldstone footing, with a stone chimney and a stoop.

home_house_2.notes: The Ranch House: a farmhouse, fieldstone below and timber above, two dormers, a porch the length of its front.

home_house_3.notes: The Ranch House: a great farmhouse with a cross wing, two chimneys, a cupola and a long porch.

home_barn_1.notes: The Barn: a shed with its hay.

home_barn_2.notes: The Barn: a barn with a silo.

home_barn_3.notes: The Barn: a great barn with two silos, a weather vane and a hay cart.

home_hatchery_1.notes: The Hatchery: an open shed under a gabled canvas, over a bed of straw.

home_hatchery_3.notes: The Hatchery: a great pavilion under a two-tiered roof, with lanterns.

home_cellar_1.notes: The Egg Cellar: a thatched shelter for the egg rack.

home_cellar_2.notes: The Egg Cellar: a cellar dug into a grassy mound.

home_cellar_3.notes: The Egg Cellar: a bigger mound with two doors.

home_brooder_1.notes: The Brooder: two warm beds under heat lamps and a glass roof.

home_brooder_3.notes: The Brooder: six warm beds and a boiler.

home_windmill_1.notes: The Windmill: a post mill, without its sails.

home_windmill_2.notes: The Windmill: a stone tower mill, without its sails.

home_windmill_3.notes: The Windmill: a tall tower mill with a gallery and a store, without its sails.

home_lodge_1.notes: The Trophy Lodge: a first cup between two banners.

home_lodge_2.notes: The Trophy Lodge: a hall of three cups.

home_lodge_3.notes: The Trophy Lodge: a great hall with the great cup in the middle.

home_den_1.notes: The Titan's Den: a timber frame in the mouth of a cave in a hill.

home_den_2.notes: The Titan's Den: a stone gate into a hall dug into a hill.

home_den_3.notes: The Titan's Den: a great stone gate with tusks, banners and braziers.

creature_giraffe.notes: Giraffe (ForgeGUI): golden with brown angular patches.

creature_giraffe_diamond.notes: Diamond Giraffe (ForgeGUI, mythic): pale crystal set with cut diamonds in silver.

scenery_tree_1.notes: A broad faceted tree, mid green.

scenery_tree_2.notes: A broad faceted tree, light green.

scenery_tree_3.notes: A tall narrow faceted tree, cool green.

scenery_bush_1.notes: A low faceted bush with a few flowers.

skin_lion.notes: Skinned Lion (decision 0090, a trial): the Sun Lion built in Blender (assets/lions.py), whole, on a 19-bone skeleton; clips in clips/lion.json.
